back: Mean scaling: divide by mean(|x|). Then uniform quantization into bins; each bin is a token id.

front: How does Chronos produce a probabilistic forecast?
back: A T5 model samples next tokens autoregressively. Many sample paths are detokenized; their quantiles are the forecast.
A faster Chronos variant: reads patches of the context and predicts quantiles directly instead of sampling tokens.
Encoder-only. Handles univariate, multivariate and covariate tasks in one model using group attention.
Outliers make the scale huge, so normal values fall into few bins and lose precision.
